gloss: taking out the trash; garbage disposal

definitions.gloss: taking out the trash; putting out garbage for collection
definitions.explanation: the act of putting garbage out for collection on designated days

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}のゴミ{出|だ}しを{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to take out the trash this morning.

examples.japanese: ゴミ{出|だ}しは{夫|おっと}の{担当|たんとう}だ。
examples.english: Taking out the trash is my husband's job.

examples.japanese: ゴミ{出|だ}しのルールは{地域|ちいき}によって{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: The rules for taking out trash vary by region.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, garbage collection follows strict schedules and sorting rules. Different types of garbage are collected on different days.

COMMON GARBAGE TYPES:
- {可燃|かねん}ゴミ / {燃|も}えるゴミ (burnable garbage)
- {不燃|ふねん}ゴミ / {燃|も}えないゴミ (non-burnable garbage)
- {資源|しげん}ゴミ (recyclables)
- {粗大|そだい}ゴミ (bulky waste)

USAGE:
- ゴミ{出|だ}しをする (to take out the trash)
- ゴミ{出|だ}しの{日|ひ} (garbage collection day)
